messages:
alex: Starting the scheduled migration for payments -> adding partial index on (metadata->>'country') to speed regional queries. Target window 23:00-23:30 UTC. Planning to pin service-version=release-2026-02-14 for the rollout.
deploybot: Canary job created: migration-runner v1.12. Canary shard: s3. Holdpoint set after 50 rows processed. Status: https://deployments.internal/r/1747098765 (canary)
sam: ack — i'll watch p95 and replica lag from my side.
maria: did a quick preflight. EXPLAIN ANALYZE on sample shows index lookup ~12ms on 10k rows. SQL we plan to run: ```CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_payments_country ON payments ((metadata->>'country')) WHERE (status = 'complete');```
ops-bot: baseline metrics pulled: p50 45ms, p95 180ms, replica_lag median 1s. Alerts: none.
alex: kicking the canary now — please call out any sustained >2s locks or replica lag >10s.
deploybot: Canary progressed: 50 rows applied. No locks >500ms observed. Next phase: backfill ~10k rows at rate 200/s. Auto-abort on replication lag >20s or DB lock >2s.
sam: seeing a small write latency bump +30ms at t=+2m (from canary start). watching.
maria: confirm we're running CONCURRENTLY build. if any lock >2s we should abort. Also confirmed vacuum_enabled on the DB.
ops-bot: monitoring window: replica_lag trending upward, current s3 lag 12s (threshold breached).
alex: holdpoint — pause backfill. @deploybot pause migration-runner canary now.
deploybot: Action: pausing backfill jobs for migration-runner canary on s3. Jobs suspended, state saved. Current qps impact: -5%. Checkpoint preserved id=chk_1747098800.
maria: looking at pg_stat_activity — one autovacuum worker climbing CPU but not holding locks. still investigating.
sam: can we try backing off rate to 50/s and resume? prefer to avoid full rollback if we can.
alex: agreed. Try a slower pace. Pin remains set to release-2026-02-14 while we validate.
deploybot: Resuming backfill at 50/s (new rate). Next checkpoint and healthcheck in 5m.
# ~7 minutes later~
sam: after ~7m into resumed run p95 latency still elevated +80ms vs baseline, replica lag climbed to 30s on s3, and a small number (~0.4%) of 502s from write proxy observed.
alex: this is beyond our canary SLA. decision time: roll back canary and revert schema change. Maria — can you confirm revert script is safe to run?
maria: yep. Revert plan: stop migration-runner jobs, DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_payments_country, cleanup backfill state. I'll run the revert and monitor. Revert SQL: ```DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_payments_country;```
deploybot: Executing rollback: stopping all migration-runner jobs for canary, scheduling revert on shard s3. Rollback started at ts=1747099100.
ops-bot: Alert: rollback completed on canary shard s3 at ts=1747099100. Post-rollback metrics: p50 46ms, p95 185ms, replica_lag back to ~1s. No user-facing incidents.
sam: confirming metrics — p95 back to baseline, replica lag cleared.
alex: thanks. We'll schedule a slower, more defensive rollout next window with reduced batch sizes, replica warm-up checks, and a preflight replica catch-up gating. Update release notes: rolled back concurrent index in canary due to sustained replica lag; follow-up ticket INF-1234 created.
maria: opening PR with adjusted backfill config (default rate 25/s, extra lag-check timeout, add preflight catch-up probe). cc @oncall.
sam: :thumbsup: please add postmortem notes to the ticket with graphs (p95, replica lag, errors).
alex: thanks everyone for fast responses. closing this thread — we'll reattempt after the follow-ups land.
